requirement.value: Confidence Man mastery — "You must have mastered this class" (AzureProject Trickster doc p.3, verified 10 Aug 2026)

system.description: When you make a weapon attack, you may instead disguise it as a feint and prepare a Secret Action with the trigger: "When the target next makes an attack roll." When triggered, you strike first, dealing 5 extra damage with your weapon attack. If the attack hits, the target suffers a -2 penalty to their next check. The word "instead" is why this costs your action. (AzureProject Trickster doc p.3, verified 10 Aug 2026 — the audit had held one clause of this.)
